correctness.rationale: For every k>=1 the cubic factorization is exact modulo 2^k. Odd-s slices have exactly two Hensel branches; even-s slices reduce with correct 2^v lifting factor to a square map at depth k−v. B_m=m2^m is proved using odd/even pair decomposition and Q_m by square-image recursion. Both global sums and the probability-normalized Fourier fourth moment follow algebraically. Exhaustive integer checks through k=10 corroborate each coefficient.
